description.description: Brief description of the page for admin reference

layout_type.description: Which layout to use when rendering the page

element_ids.description: Ordered array of IEditPageElement IDs that make up this page

hide_chrome.description: When true, the page renders without header, footer, or sidebar — just the page content

public_chrome.description: For public-layout rendering, which site chrome to show: both | none | header | footer

folder_id.description: Admin page-manager folder this page is filed under (IEditPageFolder id). Null = root/unfiled view. Organisation-only; does not affect public rendering.

pinned_at.description: When set, the page is pinned to the top of its folder view in the admin page manager

builder_type.description: Which page builder this page uses: 'iedit' (legacy element renderer), 'canvas' (Canvas Builder), or 'ai_static' (read-only AI-generated static HTML/CSS; no editor). Set at creation; immutable afterwards.

static_html.description: Sanitized static body HTML. Only used when builder_type = 'ai_static'. Written exclusively by platform tooling (store-time sanitisation via api/_lib/staticPageContent.js); the generic entity API strips this field from create/update payloads.

static_css.description: Page CSS for builder_type = 'ai_static', scoped at store time so every selector starts with [data-static-page="<page id>"]. Written exclusively by platform tooling; stripped from entity API payloads.

microsite_id.description: Microsite this page belongs to (task #2426). Null = default tenant site. Assigned pages are served at /{microsite prefix}/{slug} with the microsite's chrome.
